description: Imports rows from your spreadsheet as your own products, published to Printlooper sellers. Run preview_catalog_import first and get the user to agree. All rows must be valid; nothing is imported if any row has a problem. Rows from the shop spreadsheet, one per product or variant. Each needs title, wholesale_price (your price to sellers) and photo_url (a public https image). Rows with the same title become variants of one product (give variant_title and optional variant_sku and variant_price). Optional: description, tags, storefront_price, material_label, care_instructions and warnings (at least 40 characters each, printed on the card in the box). Needs a connected Printlooper account.
name: import_catalog
title: Import products
